information:
This is a multi-location FMC competition recognized by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/) as the Southern [Regional FMC Championship](https://cubingusa.org/regional) for 2024.
The following states are eligible for the title of Southern FMC Champion: 

- Arkansas
- Louisiana
- Mississippi
- Oklahoma
- Texas 

Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernFMCChampionship2024#39771-locations) for more information about the locations.

For a more normal competition experience, check out [CubingUSA Southern Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2024).

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
